title: Play-cost modal mislabels the optional 3 XP additional cost.
expected: modals.js:183-190 — describePlayVariant only checks spec.energy and spec.power; for safety-inspector.ts:13 additionalCost {xp:3} parts is empty so extra="additional cost" and it unconditionally returns label "Play + Accelerate", detail "5 + additional cost — enters ready". No xp branch exists; label is wrong for XP additional costs.
observed: Modal shows "Play + Accelerate — 5 + additional cost — enters ready" (describePlayVariant in public/js/gameplay/render/modals.js ignores additionalCostSpec.xp and falls through to the Accelerate label). Choosing it did correctly spend 3 XP and the unit entered exhausted, so only the label is wrong/misleading.
